hypothesis: Integrating deep learning models for weather forecasting with agricultural yield prediction systems could enhance the accuracy and scalability of yield forecasts by leveraging comprehensive weather data and advanced computational methods. Deep learning models, which can incorporate a wide range of observational factors and utilize 4D networks, offer potential improvements in weather prediction accuracy and computational efficiency [pangu-weather:26]. These advancements can be applied to agricultural yield prediction, where scalable models already utilize weather and soil data without requiring extensive remote sensing inputs, thus providing fast and region-specific yield forecasts [crop-yield-rs:1].
